Fresh Ingredients and Awesome Tastes
Jan 2025 • Family
One of the best meals we had in Vietnam - fresh ingredients and refreshing fruit drinks. There were 9 in our party with a variety of food preferences. Vegans will definitely be very happy here but you can also add Chicken or Eggs to dishes easily for those who prefer non-vegan. The Chia pudding was awesome as were the different vege and fruit bowls. Decor was pretty cool/they used old doors and window shutters for the tables. Pretty garden entrance at the front. Note they take cash only so go prepared.
